skill.summary: Build a complete mnemonic device or memory palace for anything the user needs to memorize, recall, or remember. Use this skill whenever someone wants to memo...

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release — build and deliver ready-to-use mnemonic devices and memory palaces.

- Analyze user material and recall context to choose the best mnemonic technique.
- Construct complete mnemonic devices: acronyms, chunking, rhymes, peg systems, or memory palaces.
- Provide vivid location and image assignments for method of loci/memory palace approaches.
- Output includes a 3-session spaced rehearsal plan to aid recall.
- Designed for anyone needing rapid, reliable recall; requires prior understanding of the material.
